summary: Make slashless and trailing-slash entry points for every current and future user-facing EKODI canonical service root resolve to one canonical behavior, preventing base-path and browser-asset regressions.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed on 2026-10-06 that the /ai and /ai/ equivalence rule be established as a forced execution rule.
implementation: Canonicalize slashless user-facing execution roots with HTTP 308 to their trailing-slash root in canonical-surface-router.js
Exclude API-only, nested API and exact routes
Require inherited regression coverage for current and future registered public execution surfaces
verification: production verification of slashless and trailing-slash entry behavior
rollback: Revert only through a constitutional amendment if canonical slash normalization causes a verified service incompatibility; do not silently disable the inherited rule per service.
